description: Source file for NotificationsRepository class which manages in-app notifications for a Kotlin-based Android frontend. It handles fetching, updating, grouping, and local storage of notification items, as well as marking notifications as read, dismissing, and inserting demo data.

classes.name: NotificationsRepository
classes.description: Repository managing in-app notification data, including fetching from backend, local persistence, grouping, and updates.

methods.name: fetchLatest
methods.description: Fetches latest notifications from backend, merges with local data, and updates local state.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read both locally and attempts to update backend.

methods.name: markAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read locally and attempts to update backend.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Removes a notification locally; returns the removed item for potential undo.

methods.name: undoDismiss
methods.description: Restores a dismissed notification to local storage.

methods.name: bucketFor
methods.description: Determines the time bucket (Today, This Week, Earlier) for a notification based on creation time.

methods.name: groupForUi
methods.description: Groups notifications into sections based on time buckets for UI display.

methods.name: insertLocal
methods.description: Inserts a local-only notification for display, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: seedDemoIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds demo notifications if local store is empty to improve onboarding experience.

methods.name: setAndPersist
methods.description: Updates local notification list and persists it to storage.
